# EMI by Razorpay

Using Razorpay POS, you can let your customers use EMI as a payment method to buy various products on EMI using their cards without paying the entire amount immediately. Razorpay supports EMIs on cards issued by major banks.

## EMI by Razorpay Catalog (Brand EMI)

The EMI by Razorpay Catalog (Brand EMI) on POS simplifies the EMI transaction process by allowing easy discovery of No Cost EMI, Low Cost EMI, and other applicable offers on products.
